decisions.reason: The burner component quietly supports the core gas radiant heater business at little cost, and while the firm is growing with slack there is no shortfall to prompt cutting it, though its low visibility keeps it the most exposed item.
This multi-model flagship electric infrared panel line fits the firm's electrification and decarbonisation direction and meets aspirations in a growing market, so management keeps it.
The halogen heater rounds out the electric portfolio for spot and outdoor heating, and without a reported performance shortfall there is no trigger for problemistic search or for dropping it.
The industrial electric hall heater line sits close to the core offer for logistics and industrial halls and likely performs at or above aspiration.
The hydrogen-ready dark infrared line is a strategic flagship already in real operation, and slack from expansion lets the firm carry its uncertain but future-oriented results.
